author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಂಧಿಸಿರೆ ನಿನಮನವ ಅಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮ ವಿಷಯದಲಿ
ಸಂಧಿಸುವೆ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಬಲದಿ
ವಂಧಿಮಾಗಧರಂತೆ ಅಧಿವಿಷಯ ಸಿಗುತಿರಲು
ಸಿಂಧುವಹು ಜೀವನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you bind your mind to things of the spirit,
you will reach your goal by the strength of practice;
and as the higher truths come to you, like bards singing praise,
your life becomes an ocean, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Fix the mind on the spiritual and steady practice will carry you to the goal. As deeper understanding comes, life grows vast and full like the sea.
